name: io
modification: 1024/2048-wide ETC1S KTX2 with mipmaps from USGS color-merge mosaic. Source pixel orientation and color retained; one-pixel aspect rounding normalized. No synthesized terrain or displacement.
limitation: Enhanced/false-color Galileo and Voyager merged mosaic with varying spatial resolution; not natural eye color. See USGS product description.

name: europa
credit: NASA Visualization Technology Applications and Development (VTAD)
modification: Extract embedded baseColorTexture from NASA VTAD glTF; resize to 1024/1440-wide ETC1S KTX2 with mipmaps. Source pixel orientation and color retained, no tint or synthesized terrain.
limitation: NASA visualization texture, not a calibrated true-color or albedo measurement. Regional detail and source processing vary; landmark registration remains separately validated.
